experiment: P1 FRONTIER: port the two Qwen-only pillars -- the DROPWATCH algorithm and the N2 natural-document chain -- to a frontier model (gpt-5.4-mini), which P0 proved sits in the decay regime (tau=0.50, moat 0.77, floor lever +0.19, all gates PASS).
why: Round-7 gap: the paper's METHOD contribution (DROPWATCH) and its strongest external-validity leg (N2 natural prose) were each demonstrated on Qwen2.5-7B only. A single-model algorithm result is weak for a method-paper headline. gpt-5.4-mini is the natural carrier: cheap, and P0-proven to forget (in fact faster than Qwen).
model: openai/gpt-5.4-mini (reasoning_effort='none' + temperature=0, non-reasoning mode, identical protocol to the Qwen run)

DROPWATCH.cmd: e4dropwatch.py openai gpt-5.4-mini 100 16 25 24 4 0.35 (M=24 mixed-type, K=16, budget=25, B_ri=4, theta=0.35 -- byte-identical regime to the Qwen run)
DROPWATCH.PRIMARY_GATE: dropwatch_esc strict-min minus pin_fair strict-min: paired bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND dropwatch_esc cost_per_hop <= pin_fair cost_per_hop (4.0). PASS -> observed-drop adaptive pinning beats a-priori fair pinning at no extra cost ON A FRONTIER MODEL, i.e. the method generalizes past Qwen. FAIL -> report honestly; the algorithm's advantage is model-specific and pin_fair remains the recommendation on this model.
DROPWATCH.secondary: dropwatch_esc vs pin_oracle (oracle is an inflated upper anchor, not expected to be beaten); executed cost_per_hop of dropwatch/dropwatch_esc should be < B_ri=4 (event-driven quiescence).
DROPWATCH.predictions: dropwatch_esc - pin_fair CI lower bound > 0 (point ~ +0.10..0.25, matching the Qwen +0.175); dropwatch/dropwatch_esc cost 2.5-3.8 < 4.0. RISK: frontier tau=0.5 means drops are even more front-loaded than Qwen; watchdog may saturate faster -- could help (earlier detection) or hurt (less time to recover). Honestly uncertain on magnitude; the CI-excl-0 gate is the real test.

N2_natural.cmd: n2natural.py openai gpt-5.4-mini (16 fictional prose docs x 4 facts, ks=0,1,2,4,8, budget=40, arms handoff/faithful/longctx/nofact)

PRE_REGISTERED_GATES.G3_facts_not_parametric: nofact chance <= 0.15 (fictional specifics unanswerable without the doc).

N2_natural.predictions: all four gates PASS as on Qwen (Qwen: chance .021, tau 1.39, moat replicated, faithful +0.48). RISK: gpt-5.4-mini may have SEEN more of the web and answer fictional facts by luck -> G3 chance slightly higher; still expect <= 0.15 given the specifics are authored-fictional.

honest_notes: Both runs share NOTHING with the framing cache (separate cache files cache_e4_gpt-5.4-mini.json, cache_n2_gpt-5.4-mini.json) -> safe to run concurrently.
negation facts remain unwatchable in DROPWATCH (all-'no' answers) and secondary in N2 -- same honest scope as Qwen.
This run does NOT include newstance/per-instance frontier text-predictability (still a scope statement in the paper; P3, deferred).
